system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Starships of the Galaxy

See also: Fleet Maneuvers, Starship Maneuvers

This maneuver lets you score an incredibly precise hit on the target, punching holes in vital systems and potentially disabling your target.

[Gunner]

Time: Standard Action

Targets: A single Vehicle within range.

Make an attack roll. The result of the attack roll determines the effects, if any:

RESULT EFFECT
Exceeds Target's Reflex Defense You deal normal weapon damage to the target, +1 extra die of damage.
Exceeds Target's Reflex Defense by 5 You deal normal weapon damage to the target, +2 extra dice of damage.
Exceeds Target's Reflex Defense by 10 You deal normal weapon damage to the target, +3 extra dice of damage.
